g.text: Privacy: regional cells with fewer than 50 buyers are suppressed and shown as 'n/a'.
Methodology and refresh schedule: data refreshes by day 5 each month.
Index above 100 = demand above its 24-month average.
YoY compares 3-month rolling enquiries with same period last year.
Need this in your own systems?
Get API access with 12 to 24 months of history.
Alert at 80% of quota (api_quota_warning). Rate limit 429 response documented in the API reference.
